gui_evidence.boundary: SelectFocus RVA 0x132D320 and SelectPerk RVA 0x132D1A0 install confirmation state at window+0x160 and window+0x158. They are forbidden adapter entry points because they open UI confirmation instead of submitting the gameplay command.

common_submit.ownership: The wrapper synchronously calls command primary-vtable +0x40 to create an independent heap clone, transfers that clone to the locked queue at RVA 0x341D990, and destroys a rejected clone. The adapter command remains a stack object.
common_submit.result_boundary: true proves only that the queue accepted exactly one clone. It never proves the selection was applied. LIFE6 must issue a pending ACK and verify a later fresh state receipt.

dispatch_contract: Run only on application-main while the game transaction is paused.

For a window-bound selection, re-enter LIFE5 immediately before dispatch so root, RTTI idler, handler+0x1A8 window, owner round-trip, window+0xF8, Character storage round-trip, candidate provenance and final CanSelect are freshly resolved.

For the fixed stewardship_wealth_focus windowless route, the stock focus source must re-resolve the exact focus database row, final CanSelect and target-lifestyle XP/points twice in the same paused application-main transaction. Its definition pointer may be used only in that transaction; the command adapter calls the exact final validator again immediately before submit.
Resolve the requested stable key in the fresh source. A missing or duplicate key fails closed; the stock route admits only its fixed policy target.
Construct only the exact command layout, call its final exact validator, then invoke the common submit wrapper exactly once. There is no retry.
Never call SelectFocus, SelectPerk, open, bind or refresh, and never reinterpret submit acceptance as applied state.
